result: {"ratings": {"Sofia": {"rating": 5, "why": "Sofia built the lower tail and made the tricky corner join with Jack's edge, then wisely chose not to redo it when a close look showed it was only crowded, and she kept everyone updated clearly throughout."}, "Omar": {"rating": 4, "why": "Omar finished the long bottom body line, which the tail depended on, and he communicated progress well and stayed clear of the tail, but he did little after that and could have picked up extra work like the eye."}, "Jack": {"rating": 4, "why": "Jack built the right edge of the tail and carried it down and back left to meet Sofia's line, which was the key joint, but his edge drifted at first and the gill line and eye ended up left to others or undone."}}}
